findings.finding: Post-decision live-path excursion, not covered by the adjudication. The live detector path moved a8c04fc3 -> e36b0d644ca7 at 01:06:12 (one line from a8c04fc3: line 86 widens the metalinguistic cue regex with 'quote(?:d|s)? ... detector|0 genuine assertions?'), then back to a8c04fc3 by 01:08:14, and stayed a8c04fc3 through review exit. e36b0d64 is a fifth revision, not one of the four cited arms, so it is outside the adjudicated census. The decision text says 'at this window', so the decision is not falsified; the finding is that any downstream artifact citing 'the live detector' or the path rather than a byte hash is ambiguous, and that the REC-22 freeze was not preserved after the artifact was written.
findings.consequence: Bind every detector citation to bytes, not to research_map/class_separation.py. The pin of record remains c266dbec (frozen_artifacts, active) and the adjudication's APPLIED arm remains a8c04fc3.
findings.falsifier: Show that e36b0d64 was an adopted arm with a recorded authorizing artifact and a byte-identical rename, or show an artifact event that pins e36b0d64 before 01:06:12; either would make this a recorded, scoped write rather than an unadjudicated excursion.

findings.finding: The adjudication's census harness is not pinned in the artifact. Only aggregate matrices and per-fixture classifications are published, so the exact firing decisions on corpus_c/corpus_d rows cannot be re-derived from the artifact alone. The aggregate arithmetic and the two central behavior claims do reproduce independently here (27-fixture 17/0/10/0 on all four arms; frozen-snapshot hard totals 19/24/25/1), but a successor artifact should carry the harness hash and the fixture texts or hashes.
findings.consequence: Reproducibility gap only; it does not change decision (c).
findings.falsifier: A pinned harness + fixture set that, re-run at the same bytes, produces a different per-arm matrix than the artifact records.

findings.finding: Field-scope ambiguity. `corpus_b_live.<arm>.labeled_claims` is an arm-invariant 14-claim label list (identical in all four arms); two of its entries (claims[127], claims[187]) are not flagged by the APPLIED arm at the snapshot, while the decision's '17 labeled FP' is exactly the 17 rows of `labeled_detail`. The split 17+2=19 is correct by rows; the field name invites a per-arm reading it does not have.
findings.consequence: Documentation only; recommend renaming to a global label list (or publishing the per-arm flagged-labeled set) in any successor artifact.
findings.falsifier: Show that a consumer cannot misread it, or that the field was already documented as global.

falsifier: This review is void if any cited pin moves (reviews/CLASSSEP-calibration-adjudication.json leaving 7714ffd5, the frozen snapshot leaving f344ed2a, or any of the four arm bytes leaving its cited sha); it is falsified if an arm at the pinned bytes meets the declared adoption bar, if a genuine first-order C0/C2 merge assertion is found inside the 17 labeled rows, or if the frozen snapshot contains a claim whose APPLIED hard finding was omitted from the 19.
